警視廳統計書 1938

Keishichō tōkeisho (Statistical Report of the Metropolitan Police Board), 第48回, 昭和13年 (1938)
警視廳 (Metropolitan Police Board), 東京, 1939 (昭和14年刊行)

All 260 numbered tables are transcribed; the printed contents are given as the table of contents, and the chapter dividers are not reproduced. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from full-resolution crops, with no checking by eye; two long lists (arrests by offence, summary judgments by offence) were read in sections by several readers and joined. Blurred station names were checked against the station list printed throughout the book (the printed order can differ from table to table and is kept). Where a 3 could be an 8 and only one reading makes the printed total reconcile — the cell being the only doubtful one in that sum — that reading is used and noted. Printed totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. 107 of about 216,000 filled cells could not be read and are marked [?].
